title: Adherence Below Eighty Percent
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prescription:adherence doses_taken=* doses_scheduled=* drug_name=*
| eval adherence_pct=round(100*doses_taken/nullif(doses_scheduled,0),1)
| where adherence_pct<80
| stats avg(adherence_pct) as avg_adherence, count as reporting_days by drug_name
| sort avg_adherence
description: Flags medications whose dose adherence fell below eighty percent over the reporting window.
value: Missed doses on maintenance meds are invisible day to day but show up as flare-ups weeks later.
implementation: Log daily `doses_taken` and `doses_scheduled` per drug and review sub-eighty-percent streaks weekly.
visualization: Bar chart of adherence percentage by drug.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks medications you are not taking often enough according to your schedule.
